scope: Targeted manual comparison of two previously saved Gemini drafts with selected text in one 16-page SEN0390 datasheet; no new model requests or hardware access

reviewed_points.finding: Both drafts report address bytes 0x94 and 0x95 and infer the 7-bit address 0x4A. Both source pages list the two address bytes; shifting either byte right by one gives 0x4A.
Both drafts give VCC, SCL, SDA, GND and EN in the page-1 pin order. Page 1 describes EN as active high. Page 9 describes a two-wire I2C-compatible interface at up to 400 kHz.

Both drafts repeat the page-1 supply range 2.7 to 6 V and report 0.7 mA. Page 1 calls the 0.7 mA figure full-load consumption and describes current as less than 0.8 mA; page 3 gives a typical 700 microamp figure. The Desk draft additionally flags page-2 graphs as a possible discrepancy; those graphs were not verified in this text-only review.
Both drafts flag the register-map address 0x04 against the later references to 0x02. The text contains those differing references; the drafts do not establish the correct operation.
Both drafts flag the 0x00-0x03 light-register map against page 14's reference to 0x03 and 0x04. The source contains both references; the review does not resolve which transaction is correct.

The source states 112 bytes but the page-5 table displays endpoints 0x10 and 0x80, which span 113 addresses if both are inclusive. The Desk draft flags this ambiguity; the CLI draft repeats the capacity and range without flagging it.

The source uses both lumens and lux. The CLI draft explicitly flags the inconsistent units; the Desk draft reproduces both without listing the unit issue as unresolved. Neither result alone establishes calibrated lux.
Both drafts report the page-3 default integration time of 100 ms. The Desk draft also lists the page-7 selectable settings from 800 to 6.25 ms.

limitations: This is a targeted comparison of selected claims, not a complete audit of every fact, note or cited page in either draft.
Page-2 graphs and other diagrams were not visually reviewed; do not treat their claims as verified.

The two outputs are earlier live samples without a frozen evaluation protocol, reference set, repeated trials or independent reviewer. They cannot establish model accuracy, reliability or performance on other devices.

The review verifies what the PDF says and arithmetic on its address bytes; it does not establish the sensor's electrical safety, transaction sequence, calibrated units, driver support or hardware qualification.
Generated drafts remain untrusted and do not authorize device commands or profile application.
